## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `data.key` | `string` | The integration's key. |
| `data.label` | `string` | The integration's name as shown. |
| `data.kind` | `string` | `push`: each matching event becomes one partner call. `sync`: a two-way record sync with its own routes. One of `push`, `sync`. |
| `data.category` | `string` | The integration's category. One of `crm`, `affiliate`. |
| `data.blurb` | `string` | A one-line description of the integration. |
| `data.icon` | `object` | `monogram` always present; `src` is a dashboard-local asset path when one ships. |
| `data.connect_method` | `string` | `api_key`: post `credentials` to `…/connect`. `oauth`: the integration's own install flow. One of `api_key`, `oauth`. |
| `data.event_types` | `array of string` | The events a push integration acts on. Fixed by the integration. |
| `data.credentials` | `array of object` | What a push integration authenticates with, in form order. Post them as `credentials`, keyed by `key`. |
| `data.fields` | `array of object` | Extra settings, posted as `config`. |
| `data.prerequisite` | `object` | Something that must be set up outside tmbilling first. |
| `data.status` | `string` | The business integration's status. One of `not_connected`, `active`, `disabled`, `reauth_required`. |
| `data.summary` | `string` | One line, such as the HubSpot portal domain. |
